# pay-agent

An AI agent that autonomously purchases data from x402-protected APIs using Hedera micropayments.
Submitted for the Hedera x402 Bounty (hedera.com/x402-bounty).

## Project Structure

- packages/server — Express API server with x402 resource server and AI agent
- packages/web — React (Vite) dashboard

## Key Technologies

- x402 protocol (@x402/express, @x402/core, @x402/fetch, @x402/hedera)
- Hedera testnet (hedera:testnet) — HBAR micropayments, ~$0.0001/tx
- Ollama LLM (@langchain/ollama) for agent reasoning
- LangChain for tool orchestration
- x402.org facilitator handles verification and settlement

## x402 Flow

1. Client requests a protected endpoint
2. Server responds with HTTP 402 + payment instructions in headers
3. Client signs a Hedera TransferTransaction using @x402/hedera
4. Client retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
5. Server verifies via x402.org facilitator, settles on Hedera
6. Server responds with data + PAYMENT-RESPONSE receipt

## Hedera Details

- Network: hedera:testnet
- USDC Token ID: 0.0.429274 (6 decimals)
- HBAR supported as native token (asset ID 0.0.0)
- Facilitator: https://x402.org/facilitator (supports hedera:testnet)
- Block explorer: https://hashscan.io/testnet

## x402 SDK Reference

Server-side:
- paymentMiddleware() from @x402/express wraps Express routes
- ExactHederaScheme from @x402/hedera/exact/server for Hedera settlement
- x402ResourceServer + HTTPFacilitatorClient from @x402/core/server

Client-side:
- createClientHederaSigner from @x402/hedera for signing payments
- ExactHederaScheme from @x402/hedera/exact/client for client-side signing
- wrapFetchWithPayment from @x402/fetch to auto-handle 402 responses
- x402Client from @x402/core/client to register payment schemes

## Environment Variables

HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID — Hedera testnet account ID (e.g. 0.0.12345)
HEDERA_PRIVATE_KEY — ECDSA private key for the account
OLLAMA_BASE_URL — Ollama server URL (default: http://localhost:11434)
OLLAMA_MODEL — Model to use (default: llama3.2:3b)
PORT — Server port (default: 4021)
FACILITATOR_URL — x402 facilitator URL (default: https://x402.org/facilitator)
